Stackagram Privacy Policy

Last updated: April 22, 2026

Stackagram does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All game progress, scores, and settings are stored locally on your device using standard on-device storage and are never sent to any server.

Data Collection

We do not collect any data. No analytics, no tracking, no personal information.

Third-Party Services

Stackagram does not use any third-party services, SDKs, or analytics tools.

Children’s Privacy

Stackagram does not collect data from any user, including children.

Contact
